headline: Celestis Best Build
title: Celestis Build | Star Glide EP trick | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Celestis is a Dark ranged Aniimo with just two skills, and both matter. Star Glide flies overhead and drops stars. Hit the same target three times with it and Celestis recovers EP faster for a short time. Then use Shooting Stars to fire stars at your target. Open with Star Glide, then spam the stars. At level eighteen it can evolve into Stellarys. Do you run Celestis? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Celestis build: Star Glide hits three times for faster EP recovery, then Shooting Stars; evolves toward Stellarys at level 18.
